description: File uploads, agent artifacts and memory browser

files.emptyDir: Empty folder — drop files or click upload
files.truncatedPreview: This file is large, so only the first {{limit}} is previewed. Inline editing is disabled to avoid saving truncated content; download the file for the full contents.

preview.htmlSandbox: HTML is rendered in a restricted sandbox. Scripts will not run.
preview.jsonParseFailed: JSON parsing failed, so the original text is shown.
preview.jsonlParseFailed: {{count}} JSONL line(s) could not be parsed and were kept as original text.
preview.csvTruncated: Preview limited to {{rows}} rows and {{columns}} columns.
preview.pdfCanvasUnavailable: Canvas rendering is not available in this environment.
preview.unsupportedDesc: This file type is not supported for inline preview. You can download it or open its containing folder.

knowledge.loadFailed: Could not load knowledge data. Check the service and try again.
knowledge.name: Name

connection.title: Connection settings
connection.keyExistingHint: An API Key is saved. Leave blank to keep it when the URL is unchanged; enter it again if you change the URL.
connection.keyNewHint: Enter your RAGFlow API Key. Stored keys are never shown here.
connection.loadFailed: Could not load connection settings. Try again.
connection.saveFailed: Could not save the connection. Check your settings and try again.
connection.notApplied: The server did not apply the connection. Your current view has not been refreshed.

errors.invalid_request: Invalid connection settings. Check the URL and API Key.
errors.api_key_required: Enter an API Key. A saved key cannot be reused when the URL changes.
errors.connection_test_failed: RAGFlow connection check failed. Check the URL, API Key and service status. Changes were not saved.
errors.knowledgebase_config_overridden: This connection is managed by another configuration and cannot be saved here.
errors.knowledgebase_config_invalid: Existing knowledgebase settings or credentials cannot be read; check the configuration files.
errors.knowledgebase_config_changed: Connection settings changed elsewhere. Reopen the drawer and try again.
errors.knowledgebase_save_failed: Connection check passed but saving failed. Try again later.
errors.request_too_large: Request content is too long. Check your inputs.

unavailable.title: Knowledge integration status
unavailable.integration_pendingHint: The knowledge backend is not mounted in this installation. Ask an administrator to complete the backend integration, then check again. No files or Knowledge Sets have been loaded.
unavailable.knowledgebase_not_configuredHint: Configure RAGFlow in Connection settings. Changes take effect after saving. File and Knowledge Set actions remain disabled until the service reports ready.
unavailable.knowledgebase_unavailableHint: Check the knowledge service connection and backend availability with an administrator, then check again. This is not an empty knowledge base.

files.title: Files
files.description: Manage source files, preview originals, and associate the same file with multiple Knowledge Sets without uploading it again.
files.pageSearch: Searches files and folders in the current folder.
files.currentFolderCount: Files in the current folder, excluding folders
files.selectAll: Select all files on this page
files.empty: No matching files or folders in this folder.
files.readOnlyFolder: This folder is read-only. You can browse its contents.
files.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete the empty folder “{{name}}”? The service checks that it is empty before deletion, but the underlying operation is recursive. Make sure no concurrent uploads or other writes occur; this check is not atomic.
files.uploadHint: The selected file bytes will be uploaded to the knowledge service. Uploading does not automatically parse or index the file.
files.renameConfirm: Rename “{{name}}” to “{{newName}}”? The source file and its relationships will be retained.
files.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? This permanently removes the source and any associated Knowledge Set documents. This is not an unlink action. Non-empty folders may be rejected by the service.
files.associateHint: Choose one target Knowledge Set. Linking preserves the source file and does not start parsing automatically.
files.associated: Association request submitted and processing. Refresh the Knowledge Set later to check; parsing remains manual.
files.selectPreview: Select a file on the left to preview its content.
files.previewUnavailable: Inline preview is unavailable for this file. Download the original to view it.
files.truncated: Only part of this file is shown. Download the source for its complete contents.
files.noRelationships: Not associated with a Knowledge Set

datasets.title: Knowledge Sets
datasets.description: Organize files into knowledge collections. Knowledge Set membership does not copy or move source files.
datasets.empty: No Knowledge Sets found. Create a Knowledge Set to organize existing files.
datasets.deleteConfirm: Delete Knowledge Set “{{name}}” and its indexed documents? Source files in Knowledge Files are retained.
datasets.sessionSelectionHint: Can be selected in session context
datasets.catalogHint: Configure the embedding model in RAGFlow. Creating a Knowledge Set here uses RAGFlow's default model.
datasets.catalogUnavailable: The Flocks model catalog could not be loaded. Retry to choose a model. Existing model references are preserved.
datasets.noModels: RAGFlow has no embedding model yet. Configure one there before creating a Knowledge Set.
datasets.modelLocked: The embedding model is read only while documents are indexed or processing, or indexing state cannot be verified. Name and description can still be edited.
datasets.searchDocuments: Search linked files on this page…
datasets.pageSearch: Search filters only the currently loaded page.
datasets.noDocuments: No linked files are visible yet. Recently submitted associations may still be processing. Parsing is started manually.
datasets.refreshingDocuments: Checking for linked files for up to 20 seconds. Submitted associations may still be processing; parsing remains manual.
datasets.refreshStopped: Automatic refresh stopped. If files are still missing, their association is not yet confirmed. Refresh again later.
datasets.linkHint: Choose existing source files. Adding files preserves originals and does not start parsing automatically.
datasets.sourceUnavailableHint: Original content is unavailable because the document ID is missing.
datasets.sourcePreserved: Unlinking removes only this Knowledge Set’s document relationship and index. The source file remains in Knowledge Files.
datasets.unlinkConfirm: Unlink “{{name}}” from this Knowledge Set? Its indexed document will be removed, but the source file and other Knowledge Set relationships will be retained.

operations.title: Knowledge operation
operations.confirmed: Operation confirmed. Check the refreshed resource state for parsing progress.
operations.pendingHint: The service accepted the operation. Automatic checks are bounded; refresh the operation to check again. Parsing completion is shown in the document state, not inferred from acceptance.
operations.unknownHint: The result is uncertain. Writes are paused to prevent duplicates, and this request will not be resubmitted. Refresh the operation if an ID is available; otherwise ask an administrator to reconcile the intent below.

memory.title: Memory Files
memory.selectPrompt: Select a file on the left to preview
memory.selectDesc: Memory files are written automatically by agents like Rex to record task context and key information
